inspection_scope: read-only source/filesystem inspection only; hmz and sandbox-exec were not executed

source_findings.offline_policy: online=false with hosts=[] and listen=[] starts an hmz loopback proxy which permits no external host
source_findings.subprocesses: the trusted rlimit shim, Python/Clang frontend and descendants are launched beneath the one hmz wrapper
source_findings.nested_seatbelt: seatbelt.available() runs sandbox-exec with an allow-default profile and reports false when sandbox_apply cannot run; a process already inside a sandbox cannot apply another
source_findings.implicit_persistent_write: wrap._seatbelted() appends os.confstr(_CS_DARWIN_USER_CACHE_DIR)/mds to Seatbelt write roots even when the supplied policy does not name it
source_findings.local_ipc_residual: hmz documents local Unix sockets/Mach services and loopback semantics separately; online=false is not a proof that every local IPC or network attack is impossible

sandbox_exec.previous_operation_not_permitted_meaning: the previous RLAR/tool context could not nest sandbox_apply; it does not show that hmz has no isolation and does not establish outer-control capability

runtime_compatibility.required_resolution: a source-audited hmz protocol that does not grant persistent writes outside attempt/build, followed by the outer probe; do not hide the grant or weaken the attempt contract
